While technically true that they aren't seen, the taxonomy states they become 'less prominent with age'. A smooth shell in an adult is a valid state for this class. Therefore, marking it 'false' implies a defect or mismatch, whereas it is likely a correct representation of an adult. I will adjust the interpretation to view the smooth shell as consistent with the 'adult' clause of the taxonomy, effectively treating the alignment as positive for this feature, provided no other anomalies exist.
